RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 0

Both you and the successful candidate are men, meaning your sex was not a deciding factor in the appointment. Claiming gender bias will undermine your credibility and distract from constructive dialogue.

While an all-male panel may reflect poor diversity practices or a breach of internal public broadcaster composition guidelines, it did not disadvantage you on the basis of sex. The outcome appears to have turned on the broadcaster's strategic prioritisation of digital media skills over traditional newsroom tenure. 

Follow up politely to obtain your promised written feedback, and focus your questions on the specific criteria and competencies used to evaluate digital leadership.
